name: pappardelle
description: Install, update, configure, and monitor Pappardelle workspaces. Provides /init-pappardelle (interactive setup wizard), /update-pappardelle (update to latest version), /configure-pappardelle (interactive config editor), /sous-chef (kitchen-style workspace coordinator), and /link-pr (record a PR/MR for the workspace), plus the hooks that report Claude status to the TUI, post question answers to the issue, and send ntfy notifications.
